headline: Approved two subdivision plans and a frontage waiver and subdivision for Bridge Street, and set a April hearing for Federal Street project.
summary: The board endorsed subdivision plans for 9-11 Fillmore Street and 63 West Street, and approved a waiver of frontage and definitive subdivision for 85 and 87 Bridge Street. The board also set an April 28, 2026 public hearing for a Federal Street project and tabled the election of officers and signatory authorization until June 23, 2026.
decisions: Endorsed the Subdivision Approval Not Required Plan for 9-11 Fillmore Street, applicant John Vitale, 6-0.
Endorsed the Subdivision Approval Not Required Plan for 63 West Street, applicant 63 West Street LLC, 6-0.
Found that the waiver of frontage for 85 and 87 Bridge Street is in the public interest and consistent with the Subdivision Control Law, 6-0.
Granted the Waiver of Frontage for 85 and 87 Bridge Street, 6-0.
Approved the Definitive Subdivision Plan for 85 and 87 Bridge Street, 6-0.
Set a Public Hearing for Site Plan Review #170-26 and Special Permit #205-26 at 46 Federal Street for April 28, 2026, 6-0.
Tabled the Election of the 2026 Planning Board Chairperson and Vice-Chairperson to the June 23, 2026 meeting, 6-0.
Tabled the Authorization of the Planning Board Signatory to the June 23, 2026 meeting, 6-0.
